question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY), how much monthly pension is provided to eligible small and marginal farmers after the age of 60?
solution: The correct answer is __**₹3,000**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)** is a government-backed pension scheme introduced to provide **social security to small and marginal farmers** in India. • Under this scheme, eligible farmers receive a **monthly pension of ₹3,000** after attaining the age of 60 years. • The scheme primarily targets farmers who own **cultivable land of up to 2 hectares** and are aged between **18 and 40 years** at the time of enrolment. • Farmers are required to make a **monthly contribution** (ranging from ₹55 to ₹200 depending on their age) towards the pension fund, which is matched by an equivalent contribution from the Government of India. • The scheme is **voluntary and contributory**, ensuring long-term financial security for farmers during their old age.
